new_rows.label: Window text size
new_rows.help: The game's text in dealers, job boards and the Neural Net. Automatic follows HUD size. Applies at the main menu.

new_rows.label: Button hints
new_rows.help: Which button does what. When useful: only when something new is possible. If unsure, leave this.

new_rows.label: Hit effects
new_rows.help: Flashes at the screen's edge when your ship is hit. Choose Soft or Off if flashes bother you.

new_rows.label: Steering curve
new_rows.help: The steering response as a number: the curve's exponent, 1 = linear.

new_rows.label: Other changed settings
new_rows.help: Settings that have no row here and differ from their defaults. Reset them sets them back.

hud_style.label: HUD 2
hud_style.head: hud
hud_style.off_help: HUD 2 is disabled, so this has no effect. Your setting is kept.
hud_style.help: The new flight display and menu look. On the pad: keyboard and mouse keep the game's HUD. Disabled: the game's own HUD.

hud_size.help: Automatic: Large on a handheld, Normal elsewhere. Small is close to the game's own HUD. This page follows it.

hud_fade.label: HUD in calm flight
hud_fade.help: Fades: parts of the HUD fade out in calm flight and return when they matter. Always: everything stays.

hud_numbers.label: Numbers on the ring
hud_numbers.help: Your shield and hull as numbers beside the ring round the crosshair: when low, always, or never.

mod_controller.label: Controller
mod_controller.head: controller
mod_controller.off_help: The controller is disabled, so this has no effect. Your setting is kept.
mod_controller.help: The whole game on a controller: prompts, screens, on-screen keyboard. Takes effect at the next start.

pad_preset.label: Layout
pad_preset.help: The whole flight layout. Press {A} to see every button.

value_help.FREELANCER: Freelancer: the game's controls on a pad, the right stick steers. Press {A} to see every button.
value_help.ACE: Ace: arcade flight, the left stick steers and the triggers are the throttle. Press {A} to see every button.
value_help.ASSISTED: Assisted: the autopilot flies, you aim and decide. Press {A} to see every button.
value_help.CUSTOM: Custom: for now the same as Freelancer. Press {A} to see every button.

invert_y.label: Invert steering
invert_y.help: Stick up turns the nose down, as in a flight simulator.

aim_mode.label: Aim
aim_mode.help: Gimbal: the stick steers and the reticle locks onto your target. Reticle: the stick moves the reticle, with aim assist.

steer_expo.label: Steering response
steer_expo.help: Softer is gentler near the centre, for fine aim. If unsure, leave it on Soft.

stick_deadzone.label: Stick dead zone
stick_deadzone.help: How far a stick moves before the game reacts. Raise it if the ship drifts by itself.

rumble.label: Rumble
rumble.help: Vibration strength: hits on your ship and warnings. Zero switches it off.

glyph_style.label: Button prompts
glyph_style.help: Which button pictures to show. Automatic follows the connected controller.

weapon_groups.label: Weapon groups
weapon_groups.help: One button: one fire button. Cycle: {Y} steps through your groups. Two triggers: a group on each trigger.

holds_as_toggles.label: Held buttons
holds_as_toggles.help: Toggle: boost, reverse and rear view go on with one press and off with the next. Nothing needs holding.

edit_bindings.label: Every button
edit_bindings.help: Every button of the layout, read-only. LB and RB go through the layouts.

enabled.label: Subtitles
enabled.head: subtitles
enabled.off_help: Subtitles are disabled, so this has no effect. Your setting is kept.
enabled.help: Spoken lines as text, in flight, in bases and in cutscenes.

size.label: Text size
size.help: The size of the subtitles only. The sample above shows it.

background_opacity.label: Background
background_opacity.help: How solid the panel behind the text is. More is easier to read over bright scenes.

speaker_names.label: Speaker names
speaker_names.help: Who is speaking: on a row of its own, in front of the line, or not at all.

chatter.label: Radio chatter
chatter.help: Other pilots' talk outside the story: in the chat window, as subtitles, or off.

mod_autopilot.label: Autopilot
mod_autopilot.head: autopilot
mod_autopilot.off_help: The autopilot is disabled, so this has no effect. Your setting is kept.
mod_autopilot.help: The Advanced Autopilot, its goal panel and its button. Takes effect at the next start.

preset.label: Autopilot style
preset.help: How the autopilot flies, in one word. Changing one of its settings reads Custom.

value_help.COMPETENT: Competent: flies well, and knows only what you have seen. It uses your missiles and repairs when needed.
value_help.SPEEDRUN: Speedrun: knows everything in the game's data, flies for time and leaves loot behind.
value_help.NO CONSUMABLES: No consumables: as Competent, but it never spends your missiles, repairs or countermeasures.
value_help.CUSTOM: Custom: your own mix. Show all settings lists its rows on this tab.

start_smart.label: When it starts
start_smart.help: Objective first: the mission, then your waypoints, then your target. Target only: just the target you picked.

autopilot_cancel.label: Stick takes over
autopilot_cancel.help: How far to push the stick to take the ship back. Zero: only the autopilot button does.

skip_dock_scene.label: Skip docking scenes
skip_dock_scene.help: When the autopilot docks, skip the docking scene.

autopilot_key.label: Autopilot key
autopilot_key.help: The keyboard key that starts and stops the autopilot. A key the game already uses is refused.

ap_hints.label: Autopilot hints
ap_hints.help: Show the autopilot's prompts before you first use it. Disabled: nothing about it shows until you start it once.

mod_movies.label: Movie handling
mod_movies.head: movies
mod_movies.off_help: Movie handling is disabled, so this has no effect. Your setting is kept.
mod_movies.help: Movies fitted to the screen, the choice of intro, skipping the startup movies. Takes effect at the next start.

movie_skip.label: Startup movies
movie_skip.help: Skip goes straight to the main menu.

movie_intro.label: Intro
movie_intro.help: Which intro plays. Only the versions this install has are offered.

mod_display.label: Window handling
mod_display.head: display
mod_display.off_help: Window handling is disabled, so this has no effect. Your setting is kept.
mod_display.help: Borderless window, fit to the monitor, running in the background. Takes effect at the next start.

run_in_background.label: Keep running in background
run_in_background.help: The game normally pauses when you switch to another window.

mod_speedrun.label: Speedrun mode
mod_speedrun.head: speedrun
mod_speedrun.off_help: Speedrun mode is disabled, so this has no effect. Your setting is kept.
mod_speedrun.help: The New Game choice, the timer, the splits and LiveSplit. Takes effect at the next start.

mod_npc.label: Bug recorder
mod_npc.head: npc
mod_npc.off_help: The bug recorder is disabled, so this has no effect. Your setting is kept.
mod_npc.help: Writes a log when a ship near you stalls, for bug reports. Changes nothing in the game. Takes effect at the next start.

show_advanced.label: Show all settings
show_advanced.help: Every tab also lists the rest of its settings, as they were before this page. Advanced mode replaces this later.

reset_all.label: Reset
reset_all.help: Every FLvibed setting back to its default, hidden ones too. It asks first.

about.label: About
about.help: FLvibed {version}, its credits and licences, and where the settings files are.

first_card.title: BEFORE YOU FLY
first_card.lead: Nothing here is required. It is all in Options, FLVIBED, later too.

subtitles.label: Subtitles
subtitles.help: Spoken lines as text, and their size. The sample above shows it.

rows.help: How large the HUD and FLvibed's text are. This card follows it.
Spoken lines as text, and their size. The sample above shows it.
Flashes at the screen's edge when your ship is hit. Choose Soft or Off if flashes bother you.
Toggle: boost, reverse and rear view go on with one press and off with the next. Nothing needs holding.
